name: Claude Code
description: Installs the Claude Code CLI, mounts host Claude configuration, and installs the Claude Code VS Code extension.

instructionFilePath.description: Path to the central CLAUDE.md instruction file, relative to the workspace root. Default is empty (disabled). Set a path (e.g. '.agents/CLAUDE.md') to link it as the workspace CLAUDE.md. An existing CLAUDE.md is preserved.

rulesPath.description: Path to the rules directory, relative to the workspace root. Default is empty (disabled). Set to a path (e.g. '.agents/rules') to link it to .claude/rules.

skillsPath.description: Path to the skills directory, relative to the workspace root. Default is empty (disabled). Set a path (e.g. '.agents/skills') to link it to .claude/skills.
